successCriteria.description: The `getById` mock in `buildApp` (tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.routes.test.ts) enforces the same role-based visibility as the real `LeaveService.getById`: ADMIN sees any request; MANAGER sees `actor.id` plus direct reports; EMPLOYEE sees only `actor.id`; any other request throws `NotFoundError`.

The failing test `GET /leaves/:id returns NotFoundError for a request not visible to the actor` passes: requesting `lr-3` (owned by `emp-3`) as EMPLOYEE `emp-1` yields status 404 with `{ code: 'NOT_FOUND' }`, and the invisible-request response is byte-identical to the nonexistent-id response.

The full leave routes test suite passes (`npx jest tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.routes.test.ts`), including the existing owner-visible (200) and nonexistent-id (404) cases, with no change to production source.

constraints: The fix is confined to the test file `tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.routes.test.ts`; no production source (routes, service, repository, errors) may be modified.

The mock `getById` must mirror the real `LeaveService.getById` visibility rule (ADMIN sees all; MANAGER sees `actor.id` + direct reports; EMPLOYEE sees only `actor.id`; otherwise `NotFoundError`), not a naive find-by-id.
The invisible-request and nonexistent-id responses must be indistinguishable (same status 404 and identical body), preserving the information-hiding contract the test asserts.
outOfScope: No changes to production route handlers, `LeaveService`, repositories, or error types — the real service already enforces visibility correctly.
No new tests beyond fixing the existing failing test; the other scoping tests (list, owner-visible, nonexistent-id) already pass and are left as-is.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: ADMIN may read any request; MANAGER may read own + direct reports' requests; EMPLOYEE may read only own requests; any other request is treated as not found.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Invisible and nonexistent requests both surface as NotFoundError (404, NOT_FOUND) with indistinguishable bodies.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The mock `getById` visibility rule must match the real `LeaveService.getById` in src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts (ADMIN returns any request; MANAGER/EMPLOYEE build `visibleIds` from `actor.id` plus direct reports and throw `NotFoundError` when `request.employeeId` is not visible).
The 404 error contract must match `NotFoundError` (status 404, code `NOT_FOUND`, body `{ error, code }`) as defined in src/shared/errors/index.ts.
The mock `getById` must remain signature-compatible with `ILeaveService.getById(actor: LeaveActor, requestId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>` so the route handler's delegation is unchanged.
